title: WildMAE: Structure-Aware Masked Autoencoding for Wildlife Image Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2610.28590v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Camera-trap imagery presents substantial variation in animal appearance, illumination, background clutter, and visual degradation. Masked autoencoders (MAEs) offer a label-free framework for modeling such data through reconstruction of randomly hidden image patches. We present WildMAE, a decoder-side extension of MAE that combines local structure-aware refinement with masked-to-visible cross-attention. A zero-gated convolutional residual path introduces a two-dimensional neighborhood prior, while gated cross-attention allows masked positions to retrieve contextual information from visible-position features without replacing the original Transformer decoder. The associated training recipe progressively introduces normalized-pixel, Sobel-edge, and perceptual objectives. In the original Snapshot Serengeti study, covering 4,744 test images at 75% masking, the reported reconstruction scores were 27.90 versus 24.33 dB PSNR, 0.840 versus 0.78

translated_title: WildMAE：面向野生动物图像重建的结构感知掩码自编码
translated_abstract: 相机陷阱（camera-trap）图像在动物外观、光照条件、背景杂乱程度和视觉退化方面存在显著变化。掩码自编码器（MAE）提供了一种无需标签的框架，可通过重建随机遮挡的图像块来对此类数据进行建模。我们提出了WildMAE，这是MAE在解码器端的一种扩展，将局部结构感知细化与掩码位置到可见位置的交叉注意力相结合。一条零门控卷积残差路径引入了二维邻域先验，而门控交叉注意力使掩码位置能够从可见位置特征中检索上下文信息，同时无需替换原始的Transformer解码器。与之配套的训练方案逐步引入归一化像素、Sobel边缘和感知等训练目标。在最初的Snapshot Serengeti研究中，涵盖4,744张测试图像、掩码率为75%的条件下，所报告的重建得分为27.90对24.33 dB PSNR，0.840对0.78
tldr: WildMAE通过在MAE解码器中加入零门控卷积残差路径（提供二维邻域结构先验）与门控的掩码-可见交叉注意力机制，并结合渐进式的多目标训练策略，在75%掩码率下显著提升了野生动物相机陷阱图像的重建质量。
en_tdlr: WildMAE enhances masked autoencoders with a zero-gated convolutional residual path and gated masked-to-visible cross-attention in the decoder, plus a progressive training recipe, substantially improving reconstruction of camera-trap wildlife images at 75% masking.
